column1: computer|/kəmˈpjuːtər/|n.|计算机；电脑|基础|technology-devices|a personal computer::个人电脑;use a computer::使用电脑|The library provides a computer for each study group.::图书馆为每个学习小组提供一台电脑。|She uses a computer to organize her research notes.::她用电脑整理研究笔记。

telephone|/ˈteləfoʊn/|n.; v.|电话；打电话|基础|technology-devices|a telephone number::电话号码;answer the telephone::接电话|Please write your telephone number on the form.::请在表格上填写电话号码。|He will telephone the office before leaving.::离开前，他会给办公室打电话。

message|/ˈmesɪdʒ/|n.|消息；口信；主旨|基础|technology-communication|leave a message::留言;send a message::发消息|Please leave a message if I do not answer.::如果我没有接听，请留言。|The main message of the report is clear.::报告的主旨很明确。

information|/ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən/|n.|信息；资料|基础|technology-communication|useful information::有用的信息;information about::关于……的信息|The website provides useful information about the town.::网站提供了关于这个城镇的有用信息。|We need more information before making a decision.::作决定之前，我们需要更多信息。

digital|/ˈdɪdʒɪtəl/|adj.|数字的；数码的|基础|technology-devices|digital technology::数字技术;a digital copy::电子副本|The archive keeps a digital copy of each letter.::档案馆保存每封信的电子副本。|Digital technology has changed the way we share information.::数字技术改变了我们分享信息的方式。

device|/dɪˈvaɪs/|n.|装置；设备；手段|四级|technology-devices|a mobile device::移动设备;a safety device::安全装置|The device measures the temperature of the water.::这个装置测量水温。|Each mobile device can store a copy of the map.::每台移动设备都可以保存一份地图。

network|/ˈnetwɜːrk/|n.|网络；相互联系的系统|基础|technology-communication|a computer network::计算机网络;a transport network::交通网|The school is improving its computer network.::学校正在改善计算机网络。|The region has a large network of cycle paths.::这个地区拥有庞大的自行车道网络。

software|/ˈsɔːftwer/|n.|软件|基础|technology-computing|install software::安装软件;free software::自由软件；免费软件|The software helps us compare the results.::这个软件帮助我们比较结果。|We use free software to edit the recordings.::我们用免费软件编辑录音。

hardware|/ˈhɑːrdwer/|n.|计算机硬件；五金器具|四级|technology-computing|computer hardware::计算机硬件;hardware and software::硬件和软件|The problem may be caused by old hardware.::问题可能是由老旧硬件引起的。|The course introduces both hardware and software.::这门课程同时介绍硬件和软件。

program|/ˈproʊɡræm/|n.; v.|程序；计划；编程|四级|technology-computing|a computer program::计算机程序;a training program::培训计划|This program saves a copy of your work.::这个程序会保存一份工作副本。|The school introduced a new reading program.::学校推出了新的阅读计划。

code|/koʊd/|n.; v.|代码；密码；规范；编码|四级|technology-computing|source code::源代码;a code of conduct::行为准则|The source code is available for anyone to study.::任何人都可以研究这些源代码。|All members follow the same code of conduct.::所有成员遵守相同的行为准则。

screen|/skriːn/|n.; v.|屏幕；遮挡物；筛查|基础|technology-devices|a computer screen::电脑屏幕;screen out::筛除|The results appeared on the computer screen.::结果显示在电脑屏幕上。|The first check will screen out incomplete applications.::初步审查将筛除不完整的申请。

signal|/ˈsɪɡnəl/|n.; v.|信号；示意|基础|technology-communication|a clear signal::清晰的信号;signal a change::预示变化|The radio signal became weaker near the hills.::靠近群山时，无线电信号减弱了。|The new rules signal a change in priorities.::新规定预示着优先事项的变化。

access|/ˈækses/|n.; v.|进入；使用机会；访问|基础|access|access to::使用……的机会;gain access::获得进入权|All students have access to the library.::所有学生都可以使用图书馆。|You can access the files without an internet connection.::没有互联网连接也能访问这些文件。

accessible|/əkˈsesəbəl/|adj.|可进入的；可使用的；易理解的|基础|access|accessible to::对……可用的;easily accessible::容易到达的|The building is accessible to wheelchair users.::轮椅使用者可以进入这座建筑。|The book makes difficult ideas accessible to beginners.::这本书让初学者也能理解复杂的观点。

secure|/sɪˈkjʊr/|adj.; v.|安全的；稳固的；获得；固定|基础|secure|a secure place::安全的地方;secure a position::获得职位|Keep the original documents in a secure place.::请把原始文件保存在安全的地方。|They worked hard to secure support for the plan.::他们努力争取对计划的支持。

security|/sɪˈkjʊrəti/|n.|安全；保障；保安措施|基础|secure|data security::数据安全;a sense of security::安全感|The team reviewed the security of the system.::团队审查了系统的安全性。|A stable home can provide a sense of security.::稳定的家庭能带来安全感。

private|/ˈpraɪvət/|adj.|私人的；私有的；不公开的|基础|private|private information::私人信息;in private::私下地|Please keep this private information out of the report.::请不要把这些私人信息写进报告。|They discussed the problem in private.::他们私下讨论了这个问题。

privacy|/ˈpraɪvəsi/|n.|隐私；不受打扰的状态|四级|private|protect privacy::保护隐私;personal privacy::个人隐私|The design aims to protect personal privacy.::这项设计旨在保护个人隐私。|She needed some privacy to finish the letter.::她需要一些不受打扰的空间来写完信。

technology|/tekˈnɑːlədʒi/|n.|技术；科技|基础|technology-computing|modern technology::现代技术;information technology::信息技术|Modern technology can make some tasks easier.::现代技术可以让某些任务变得更容易。|The course explores technology used in everyday life.::这门课程探讨日常生活中使用的技术。

technique|/tekˈniːk/|n.|技巧；方法；技术|基础|technology-computing|a useful technique::有用的技巧;a research technique::研究技术|She showed us a useful technique for taking notes.::她向我们展示了一种有用的记笔记技巧。|The team developed a new technique for measuring distance.::团队开发了一种测量距离的新技术。

automatic|/ˌɔːtəˈmætɪk/|adj.|自动的；不自觉的|基础|automatic|an automatic door::自动门;automatic control::自动控制|The automatic door opened as we approached.::我们靠近时，自动门打开了。|The system has an automatic control for temperature.::这个系统具有温度自动控制功能。

automatically|/ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli/|adv.|自动地；不假思索地|四级|automatic|save automatically::自动保存;automatically adjust::自动调节|The program saves your work automatically.::这个程序会自动保存你的工作。|The lights automatically adjust when the room gets dark.::房间变暗时，灯光会自动调节。

artificial|/ˌɑːrtɪˈfɪʃəl/|adj.|人工的；人造的；不自然的|基础|technology-ideas|artificial light::人造光;artificial intelligence::人工智能|The plants were grown under artificial light.::这些植物在人造光下生长。|The discussion focused on uses of artificial intelligence.::讨论集中于人工智能的用途。

intelligence|/ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns/|n.|智力；理解能力；情报|基础|technology-ideas|artificial intelligence::人工智能;gather intelligence::收集情报|The test measures only certain aspects of intelligence.::这项测试只测量智力的某些方面。|The report uses intelligence gathered from several sources.::报告使用了从多个来源收集的情报。

efficient|/ɪˈfɪʃənt/|adj.|高效的；有效率的|四级|efficient|an efficient method::高效的方法;energy efficient::节能的|We need a more efficient way to organize the work.::我们需要更高效的工作组织方式。|The new lights are more energy efficient.::这些新灯更加节能。

efficiency|/ɪˈfɪʃənsi/|n.|效率；效能|四级|efficient|improve efficiency::提高效率;energy efficiency::能源效率|The new layout improved the efficiency of the workshop.::新布局提高了车间的效率。|The study compares the energy efficiency of different buildings.::这项研究比较了不同建筑的能源效率。

invent|/ɪnˈvent/|v.|发明；编造|基础|invent|invent a machine::发明机器;invent an excuse::编造借口|The students tried to invent a simple water filter.::学生们试图发明一个简单的滤水器。|He had to invent an excuse for being late.::他不得不编造一个迟到的借口。

innovation|/ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən/|n.|创新；新方法|四级|technology-ideas|encourage innovation::鼓励创新;technical innovation::技术创新|The project encourages innovation in public transport.::这个项目鼓励公共交通领域的创新。|This small innovation made the tool easier to use.::这一小创新让工具更容易使用。

invention|/ɪnˈvenʃən/|n.|发明；发明物；编造|基础|invent|a useful invention::有用的发明;the invention of::……的发明|The invention of the printing press changed communication.::印刷机的发明改变了传播方式。|The story was entirely a work of invention.::这个故事完全是虚构的。
